description: What the shop sells (item ids and prices, with photos, dietary labels, allergens, what's sold out, and what's in stock where the shop's POS counts it), where to collect, and which payments it takes. In chat apps that show cards, the menu appears as a card with the photos.

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

name: get_shop
title: See what a shop sells
